scope: Rillion proposals 1–8: rarity reveal, fishing, timing, scoring, answer coverage, depth world, readable layout, rating explanation
delivery: Local implementation and blind review; no deployment requested

criteria.claim: A visible cursor travels through six labelled point bands and lands on the earned rarity before continuation.
checks: common and rare answer browser captures
all six bands expose their point ranges
final tier agrees with earned score

criteria.claim: Puff anticipates, descends with line payout and bubbles, then settles; the rig remains continuous in deep water.
The earned score and rating appear immediately, followed by sinking; one timeline synchronizes the scene and depth, and no question clock runs during travel.
checks: score and rating visible from the first travel frame
no finding-your-depth placeholder or temporary zero score
pure journey boundary and duration tests

criteria.claim: All selectable prompts have explicit editorial tier anchors; list position cannot grant high rarity and exceptional rewards require explicit review.
Equivalent answer forms earn one score and confirmed valid-answer omissions are repaired without accepting unrelated answers.
Surface, twilight, midnight, abyss and hadal states have distinct scenery with blended transitions and nearby depth marks.
Question and feedback remain readable above animated scenery and all controls remain reachable.
checks: automatic feedback focus has no action highlight
deliberate Tab navigation has a visible focus ring

criteria.claim: Feedback and recap explain the ordered rating scale and show representative scored answers without inventing player statistics.
checks: common, uncommon and rare examples where available

regression_gates: Umbra real input flow, storage and responsive checks

inputs: baseline or reference URL if needed
review.aggregation: Reproduce material findings, fix failures and recheck affected criteria. A skipped criterion is a gap, not a pass.
